Day Drinker Plot : An enigmatic stranger forms an unlikely bond with a grieving bartender who lost her lover, their lives intertwining in unexpected ways.

Day Drinker is an upcoming American supernatural revenge thriller film directed by Marc Webb and written by Zach Dean. 

Day Drinker stars Johnny Depp, Madelyn Cline, and Penélope Cruz.

The film is scheduled to be released in the United States on March 26, 2027.
